name: isDosProtectionPolicyConfigured
definition: An enabled DoS Protection rule with action protect and a bound aggregate or classified DoS profile covers all sources and destinations.
population: DoS protection rules of the vsys read
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A DoS rulebase read showing an enabled rule with action protect and a bound aggregate or classified DoS profile that covers all sources and destinations.
citations: PAN-OS 11.1 XML API and configure CLI command hierarchy (docs.paloaltonetworks.com/pan-os/11-1/pan-os-panorama-api)

changeLog.change: Registered with its first implementation (synthetic-fixture tests only; no real device body replayed yet, so V0).

notes: rulebase/dos/rules/entry: action (deny, allow, protect), source, destination and protection/(aggregate|classified)/profile names are from the CLI hierarchy. Scope is judged from source and destination addresses only (zones are not). A successful reply with no DoS rules reads as nothing configured (False). vsys1 only.
